_comment: Local/opt-in build override: adds the USER-PROVIDED fine-tuned MMS-CTC Kurdish model to the bundle. The base configs (tauri.conf.json / tauri.windows.conf.json) intentionally list only the base models that scripts/fetch_models.py can download + SHA-256-verify, so hosted CI (ci.yml) and hosted release (release.yml) can build on a fresh checkout. The fine-tuned model is NOT publicly fetchable, so it can only be bundled on a machine that already has models/finetuned-mms-ckb/{model.onnx,vocab.json} on disk. Build with it via:  npm run tauri build -- --config src-tauri/tauri.finetuned.conf.json  (Tauri array-merges by REPLACEMENT, so this lists the full resource set, not just the delta). At runtime the fine-tuned engine is opt-in and presence-gated (commands.rs / pipeline.rs return a clean 'not found' when absent), so an installer built without this override simply omits that one optional engine.
